content:
The entire grid is a \(4\times 4\) square, so its area is
\[
4\cdot 4=16.
\]

The unshaded portion consists of two right triangles. Each has perpendicular legs of length \(2\), so each triangle has area
\[
\frac12(2)(2)=2.
\]

Therefore, the shaded polygon has area
\[
16-2-2=12.
\]

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
